# v0.3.35 — Avoid duplicate page reloads during updates

- Let DSH's client hot reload replace TheOne's interface. A backend version change no longer forces a second full-page boot while client modules may still be changing.
- Cancel update polling when the old client is disposed, ignore late responses, and keep only one poll running. The two-minute limit also aborts stalled requests.

Validation: five client lifecycle regression tests, existing updater tests, type checks and builds. A controlled comparison in a real DSH web runtime confirmed that the old client reloaded the page, while the fixed client retained the document and successfully replaced its interface. The native desktop error dialog has not been reliably reproduced; a complete desktop upgrade still needs verification.

When upgrading from an older version, its already-loaded client may still perform one final page reload. The new behavior applies after this version's client has loaded.

## 中文

- 移除更新成功后的重复整页刷新，由 DSH 热更新替换 TheOne 界面，避免在客户端模块切换期间再次进入启动检查。
- 插件卸载时取消旧轮询，忽略迟到的响应，防止重复轮询；两分钟超时也会取消未完成的请求。

已通过五项客户端生命周期回归测试及既有更新测试、类型检查和构建。真实 DSH 网页运行时对比确认：旧版会额外刷新，修复版在原页面完成界面替换。原生桌面错误弹窗尚未稳定复现，完整桌面升级仍需验证。

首次从旧版升级时，已经加载的旧客户端仍可能额外刷新一次；新版客户端加载后，后续更新使用修复后的逻辑。
